onboardingEvidence.provenance: On 2026-09-02 the official careers page embedded static.smartrecruiters.com/job-widget/1.8.5/script/smart_widget.js and called widget with company_code AristaNetworks, jobAdType PUBLIC, and api_url https://www.smartrecruiters.com. The token was read from official markup, not guessed.
onboardingEvidence.listingEvidence: Anonymous GET with Accept: application/json returned offset, limit, totalFound, content. Offsets 0, 100 and 200 returned 100, 100 and 34 rows, each with totalFound 234. All 234 IDs were unique.
